thread:
alex: FYI — Support ticket #C-3421: client sees 500s and +300-400ms p99. They included logs claiming requests are hitting ap-southeast-1 even though client sends X-Client-Region: us-west-2 in header. :rotating_light:

sam: what's the ingress path? LB -> edge router -> regional-router?

alex: yes LB (nginx) -> edge-pop -> regional-router. They said their partner proxy also sets cookie 'rw_region=ap-southeast-1'. Repro they provided:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Client-Region: us-west-2" -b "rw_region=ap-southeast-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They get routed to ap-southeast and see auth_fail + higher latencies.

maria: interesting — our routing precedence should prefer header over cookie. i'll check router precedence config and recent deploys.

ops-bot: deploy 3645007910 by eng-router-team: updated cookie-parsing fallback (staged)

sam: any correlation with SDK versions? older SDKs set region cookie when proxying.

alex: customer uses js-sdk@1.2.3 (proxy mode). They said it started after they switched traffic through PartnerX's proxy which injects rw_region cookie.

sre-jordan: pulling traces. trace=0xabcde shows regional-router evaluated rules and matched cookie rule because header looked empty — looks like LB trimmed duplicate header values for requests that had both header+cookie. Need to confirm if header arrives as empty string.

maria: quick mitigation proposal — flip precedence so X-Client-Region header wins over rw_region cookie, and add a sanitization step to strip rw_region cookie at the edge for hosted tenants. Can do a canary on edge-pop-11.

sam: +1 for canary, also worth adding a short-term alert for cookie/header mismatch. We should also update SDK docs.

alex: applied canary rule to edge-pop-11. Customer retried and confirmed requests now route to us-west-2 and auth/latency normalized. They sent back small logs showing new hop: us-west-2-edge

eng-support: filed follow-up GH issue #5021: "router: prefer X-Client-Region header over rw_region cookie + sanitization + docs". Assigned to eng-router-team.

maria: follow-ups: (1) validate LB behavior that can strip header values when cookie present, (2) add unit test for precedence, (3) add note in SDK changelog.

alex: thanks everyone — closing ticket after docs + deploy. :thumbsup:
